proposals: APEDA should publish a single, consistent annual guar gum export series from 2003-04 onward in rupees, dollars and tonnes, taken from DGCIS data, as a downloadable table, so the boom and bust need not be pieced together from secondary reports with differing conversion conventions.

APEDA should publish the end-use breakdown behind its statement that about 90% of guar exports go to oil and shale-gas industries, year by year, so whether exporters are diversifying into food, pharma and textile uses can be checked rather than assumed.

The Department of Land Resources should state publicly whether guar is listed as an eligible species under the wasteland and watershed programmes it administers, so the agronomic fit this post documents can be matched against an actual policy listing, which the post could not confirm exists.

The Rajasthan Agriculture Department should publish district-wise guar sowing area, yield and farm-gate price each kharif season, so the state's 72% share of output and the farmer side of the export price cycle can be tracked from a primary source rather than industry estimates.
